modalLead: Config → Bookmarks gets a tag cloud for filtering and selecting, deleting a bookmark can be undone, and the cheat sheet now opens on the shortcuts for whatever view you are in.

items.text: Filter and select from a tag cloud — Tags above the list shows every tag in use, most-used first and sized by count. Pick several and bookmarks carrying any of them match, the same OR the dashboard tag cloud uses; Select these bookmarks turns the filtered result into a ticked selection for the bulk toolbar.

Deleting a bookmark can be undone — one row or a whole selection, with Undo in the toast. Single-row delete previously had no undo at all, and the bulk one could be pushed off screen by a keyboard tip; a confirmation now takes the slot from a tip instead of queueing behind it.

Rows line up again — domain, shortcut, tags and the checking badge were spread across the full width, so their position shifted with every row's tag count and long text ran outside the card. Tags move to their own line past two, and the checking badge sits in a right-hand column with the usage line.

Long lists stay fast — the list loaded itself to the end on open instead of a page at a time, putting hundreds of rows in the page at once. Each batch now waits for a scroll, which cuts the redraw that runs on every keystroke in the search field from ~64ms to ~8ms on a 500-bookmark library.
Rows announce their position — the list is exposed as a list to screen readers, with each row carrying its number and the total for the filtered set rather than just what is currently on screen.

Opens on the view you are in — press ! from Health and the health shortcuts lead and are marked; the same for Inbox, inbox triage, and config. Nothing is hidden or reordered, and the filter still searches every section.
Printable one-page PDF — linked from Config → Overview and at the top of Config → Help, always opening in a new tab.
:help opens it too — an alias for :cheat, alongside ! and F1.
Health, inbox and triage shortcuts listed — the sheet now carries the same rows as the legends under those views, and its filter says so when nothing matches.

Header tooltips are no longer cut off — the tooltips on pages, inbox, health and config opened upwards into the top edge of the window. They open downwards now, stay inside the window near the right edge, and their key chips match the toolbar buttons at the bottom.

The Shift+B tip is a tip like any other — it was pinned to first place after install and held back every other tip until it had been seen. It now takes its turn in the normal rotation, subject to the same multi-day gap and the Show occasional keyboard tips switch.

Inbox triage keeps focus — Tab could walk out of the triage overlay into the page behind it, and closing it dropped focus to the top of the document instead of the button that opened it. Arrow keys in the snooze menu work as well.
